assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness, raising concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation in the setting of known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency.
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction.
Continuous rhythm monitoring is indicated to assess for arrhythmic burden and guide anticoagulation management.
The diagnosis codes I48.0 and I34.0 are associated with the patient's conditions.
The service in question is mobile cardiac telemetry with CPT code 93229.
The denial under code PR-204 is being appealed on the basis of the documented clinical indication.
The claim for mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) has been denied.
The determination is based on reason code PR-204, indicating that this specific service is not covered under the member's current benefit plan.
